info.description:
Importable acceptance suite for fb-posts-api.

- Folder 02 against real Apify: `npm run postman:live` (ONE controlled invocation).
- Auth header: `x-api-key` (Bearer also accepted by API).
- Never put APIFY_TOKEN in Postman variables.
